text:
aria: Quick heads-up — I paused the canary rollout for runtime v2.3.1 (1% traffic) because p99 token latency jumped ~35% on short prompts. Holding until we rule out config regressions.

michael: ack. which dashboard/metric exactly? link?

aria: Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/canary/v2.3.1. Look at route `generation.srv` p99 tokens/req, short prompts (seq<=64). See timeframe 10:12–10:24 UTC.

sasha: saw this too in our smoke tests earlier, but thought it was noise. can you paste a sample trace or logs?

aria: pasted a couple of traces — main anomaly is kernel_time on nvidia-rtx512 spikes. snippet: ```
[TRACE] request_id=ab12, seq=32, gpu_kern_ms=12.8, kv_fetch_ms=0.6, total_ms=58.3
[TRACE] request_id=ab13, seq=32, gpu_kern_ms=48.9, kv_fetch_ms=0.6, total_ms=95.6
```

julio: interesting — kernel_time went from ~10–15ms to 40–50ms on those. any changes in ops or fused kernels with this build?

aria: the build includes a new attention kernel switch and an LRU cache refactor. I pushed the kernel flag `--use-opt-attn=true` in this canary.

michael: timeline: can we run the microbench locally against the exact canary image? `perf-bot` can run that reproducibly. aria, want me to kick it off?

aria: please. command we use: ```bash
python infra/bench/run_perf.py --image=redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-canary --model=rw-medium --seq=32 --concurrency=8 --iters=200
```

perf-bot: Scheduled perf run started (run id: 20260317-01). Will post summarized metrics when done. :gear:

sasha: if perf run reproduces, options: flip kernel flag back, or revert the canary image. Which do we prefer? revert is fastest.

julio: +1 revert to last stable image to restore SLOs, then iterate on the kernel switch in a bench-only branch. Need approval from release owners to rollback.

aria: I agree. I'm preparing a rollback PR now. @michael @sasha please approve if you concur. I'll keep canary paused until we have green perf run or rollback completed.

michael: I approve the rollback. also want the perf run results for root-cause.

sasha: approve. also can we add a short circuit in canary policy to auto-pause on >20% p99 regression?

aria: noted — filing an issue to add an automatic latency gate. For now manual hold.

deploy-bot: canary rollout for runtime v2.3.1 paused by aria at 1764219876.

perf-bot: Perf run finished. Summary: p50 stable, p95 +5%, p99 +38% on short prompts. Full logs: https://logs.internal/perf/20260317-01. Attaching CSV.

michael: that matches traces. OK let's proceed with rollback. aria please post PR link when ready.

aria: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4123 — rolling back to runtime:v2.3.0. Will coordinate the revert deploy.

julio: thx. once rolled back, let's run the canary again with `--use-opt-attn=false` and a bench harness and promote only if p99 within 10% of baseline.

aria: agreed. I'll also add an explicit e2e perf gate to the release playbook. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
